description: Look up the EPA AQS code lists the other tools in this pack need — pollutant parameter codes, parameter classes, states, counties, sites and monitoring agencies. Call this FIRST to turn "ozone" into 44201 or "North Carolina" into 37. Sourced from the EPA Air Quality System. Requires an EPA AQS email + key.

_apiKey.description: EPA AQS credential as "<email>:<key>", or just "<key>" with email= set. Register at https://aqs.epa.gov/data/api/signup?email=<your-email>

email.description: The email the AQS key was issued to, if not folded into _apiKey

list.description: Which list: "classes" (parameter groups), "parametersByClass" (needs pc), "states", "countiesByState" (needs state), "sitesByCounty" (needs state + county), "cbsas", "pqaos", "mas"

pc.description: Parameter class, e.g. "CRITERIA", "AQI POLLUTANTS", "ALL" — required for parametersByClass

state.description: Two-digit state FIPS, e.g. "37" for North Carolina

name: aqs_list_parameters
title: Aqs List Parameters
